subject.title: fix(teams-meetings): join and transcribe live meetings reliably

question: Should the Teams default in-call wait remain 60 seconds once the gateway and CLI timeout contracts are made consistent?
rationale: The mechanical defects have a clear repair, but retaining a threefold longer default wait is a user-visible reliability and operation-duration choice that the Teams feature owner should explicitly confirm.

options.title: Keep 60-second readiness wait
options.body: Repair the gateway and CLI timeout propagation, retain the validated longer wait, and require live proof on the rebased head.

options.title: Restore the shorter default
options.body: Return the default to the prior wait budget if the longer interactive wait is not acceptable for normal gateway operations.

recommendation.title: Keep 60-second readiness wait
recommendation.body: Repair the gateway and CLI timeout propagation, retain the validated longer wait, and require live proof on the rebased head.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the merged Teams adapter and authored the current live-validation follow-up.
